rationale: While the price action shows a clear fade from the $10.84 high with current price sitting below both the 5-min VWAP ($8.40) and 9-EMA ($8.58) — which mechanically favors a short — the absence of any borrow rate or short interest data makes executing a short on a $1.6M market-cap, 1.03M-float instrument operationally unreliable; shares may be unavailable or prohibitively expensive to borrow. The stock has already traveled nearly 24% off its intraday high, meaning much of the fade may already be exhausted, and with a daily loss budget of only $810 remaining, the risk/reward of engaging a highly erratic micro-float instrument does not justify position entry in either direction.
